svt_mipi_cphy_serial_monitor_def_cov_data_callback Class Reference

Detailed Description

Class containing the default coverage callbacks which respond to the component coverage callbacks, calls relevant lane_xact_cov_data instance method so that sampling events can be triggered.

 svt_mipi_cphy_serial_monitor_def_cov_data_callback::lane_transaction_observed_cov
 (  svt_mipi_cphy_serial_monitor serial_mon , svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction lane_xact  ) 

Callback issued by the component to allow the testbench to collect functional coverage information from a Lane Transaction that it just received. This is called by the component immediately before placing the Lane Transaction into the output.

serial_mon - A reference to the component object issuing this callback. User's callback implementation can use this to access the public data and/or methods of the component.

lane_xact - A reference to the svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction descriptor object of interest.
